title: Cross-Misalignment Probe Transfer: Training on Deception, Testing on Sycophancy

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A universal misalignment probe would be a major practical advance. Whether misalignment types share a latent representation is a fundamental question with immediate monitoring implications. Both positive and negative results are highly informative.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training three separate linear probes on three different datasets (SycoBench, MALT, SHADE-Arena), each requiring activation extraction from model internals. Cross-application and comparison adds further complexity. Expert-level mechanistic interpretability work.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three probes, three datasets, six cross-application tests, plus a union probe. Even with a streamlined pipeline, this is a substantial experimental matrix well beyond 30 hours for beginners.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
